tools.name: compare_personal_loans
tools.description: Use when the user has a mailed loan or credit offer, wants to compare personal loan rates, is deciding whether to respond to a letter, or asks for a personal loan or rate check. Returns a soft-pull rate comparison through an independent marketplace (Upstart). Checking does not affect credit score. L

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "start_mail_analysis" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Analyze a photo of a mailed credit card offer, prescreened credit offer, personal loan offer, or other loan solicitation. Returns an independent third-pa"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
